item.tib: dbal phur gyi rtse zlog yang gsang khol du phyung ba khro bcu gsang ba'i zlog pa
item.coloph: phur pa'i man ngag drug sbyor 'di/ stag la me 'bar yi (gyi) bka' dam yin/ stong rgyung bdag gi thugs dam yin/ nub pa med phyir gter du sbas/ las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog dam nyams kha 'jam khong sgyu can gyi lag tu ma shor u ya rgya//
